1981-2415-7452-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

789-2403-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-2403-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

4881-6909-7176-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7176-7884.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Carnage to gain all creature types
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

3800-4289-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3800-4289-4687.description:
Activate Cryptolith Rite by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-728-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Melira
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

3398-6758-7839.notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-6758-7839.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Dawnsire.
Resolve the Dawnsire trigger, dealing 100 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating 100 Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-1315-2693-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
277-1315-2693-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
For each land that enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

301-1768-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and Juniper Order Ranger
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4053-5434-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5434-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-2762-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1987-2493-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Archaeomancer and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1061-4603-7297.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-7297.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-7297.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

2366-4885-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4885-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2511-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1510-3967-4574-5849.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

967-1308-3809-5147-7087.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-6568-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

1477-2558-4186.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three charge counters on it

63-1651-4013-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.
63-1651-4013-4563.notes: Because your opponents must choose to either let themselves and you investigate, or lose life, this combo will very likely result in infinite Clue tokens for you and your opponents.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1350-3617-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1350-3617-6333-6678.description:
Cast Time Walk from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

6562-6648.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
6562-6648.description:
Cause any creature to enter the battlefield under your control, triggering Jaws of Defeat.
Holding priority, cast Overkill by paying {2}{B}, giving the creature that entered -0/-9999 until end of turn.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the difference between the creature's power and toughness, using its last known information.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-3527--84.description:
Activate Spatial Binding by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Spatial Binding abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

222-527-2921-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2921-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2316-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1270-2316-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating nine 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

930-2997-3781-5231.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-2837-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-2837-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

369-413-650.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-413-650.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Iridescent Drake trigger, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

175-3525-3666.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3525-3666.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

4125-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

974-1953-3398.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Hellkite Charger does not have summoning sickness.
Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
974-1953-3398.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing all tokens you control to become copies of the Smaug token.
Put all but one Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Myr dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1887-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1887-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Aetherstorm Roc, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-4096.notablePrerequisites:
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
You have at least one artifact creature in your graveyard.
1636-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing any artifact creature you control and returning any other artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

147-972.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saheeli's Artistry
147-972.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saheeli's Artistry, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Saheeli's Artistry, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-972.notes: You may choose both of Saheeli's Artistry's modes, if desired.

2026-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

914-2232.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken nonartifact creature.
Opponents control a number of artifacts and/or enchantments equal to or greater than three plus the mana value of the additional nonartifact creature card.
914-2232.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and/or enchantments your opponent control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the additional nontoken nonartifact creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the additional creature card.
Cast the additional creature by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
